shell_commands: npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts 2>&1 | head -20

git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(transport): add spec links and fix eslint/format issues

- Add list_sessions and session_list specs to hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
- Add spec validation links to statements in spec
- Fix prefer-early-return pattern in conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
- Fix multiple expect calls in validation.test.ts (combine into single expect)
- Extract delegatingStore helper to wsTestSupport.ts to eliminate duplication
- Update sessionResume.test.ts and conversationList.acceptance.test.ts to use shared helper
EOF
)" && git status
npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/sender.ts src/transport/createServer.ts 2>&1 | head -10

git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(transport): implement list_sessions handler and wire sessionStore

- Add handleListSessions function to messageHandler.ts
- Thread sessionStore into createMessageHandler as optional parameter
- Add sendSessionList helper function to sender.ts
- Convert Date fields to ISO strings when serializing session summaries
- Wire sessionStore into createServer.ts
- Add unit test for sendSessionList function
- Handler calls store.listFor with session.userId, ignoring any userId in the frame
- Empty array returned when store has no listFor method
- Server errors logged with userId when listFor throws
EOF
)" && git status

git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
chore: update spec line numbers and mark facets complete

- Update conversation-list spec with corrected test line numbers
- Mark all facets as complete in dod.md
EOF
)" && git status
git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
